name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of slash-command workflows that walk an AI coding assistant through an entire software project the way a senior engineer would, from spec to shipped code.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev shop that wants their AI coding assistant to produce more reliable, less buggy code without hiring a senior engineer to review everything.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses these commands as a built-in QA process, letting them take on more client work without a second reviewer.
A coding bootcamp licenses a customized version of these skills to teach students professional engineering discipline alongside AI tools.
A dev tooling startup bundles a polished version of this workflow into a paid 'AI pair-engineer' product for small teams.

money_ideas.idea: Paid onboarding/training service teaching dev teams to adopt this workflow with their AI coding tools
A hosted, supported version of the workflow sold to small dev teams

steal_this: Install this skill set, run it on a real freelance client project this week, and use the before/after bug count as a case study to sell 'AI-assisted QA' to other clients.
